posts.title: Told You So: I-638 Is Coming for the Girls It Promised to Protect
posts.description: Washington families are scrambling to get girls' sex-verification forms signed before I-638's Dec. 3 deadline. Doctors say it can't be done.

posts.title: The Cameras Came Back. The Rules Didn't.
posts.description: Seattle's mayor campaigned against police cameras, then switched them on a day after an audit found the protections are habits, not rules.

posts.title: Jonathan Choe and the Business of Fear
posts.description: Fired by Sinclair’s KOMO over a Proud Boys promo, Jonathan Choe rebuilt himself as the right wing’s favorite Seattle backdrop.
